# PDF.js 5.6.205

Locally bundled `pdf.min.mjs` and `pdf.worker.min.mjs` from Mozilla's `pdfjs-dist` 5.6.205, with its Apache-2.0 LICENSE. No CDN or frontend build is required. Used only to paint server-generated PDF pages into canvas; evaluation/XFA are disabled and no PDF scripting or annotation actions are executed.

Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
